The k=1 singular Wishart boundary is treated separately by a uniform circle calculation; k=2 follows by integration by parts to a complete elliptic E. Strictness excludes theta=pi/4; denominators positive a.s. Computational checks are corroborative, not substituted for general proofs.

value.rationale: Ordering two Rayleigh estimates is a natural eigenvalue candidate-selection operation, and approximate Rayleigh--Ritz loses deterministic min--max guarantees under sketching. The theorem makes that risk exact in a basic nontrivial two-mode family, quantifying how candidate overlap controls both the full finite-row probability and the sharp exponential rate, while the eigenvalue gap cancels. The one- and two-row forms and the noncommuting rho-to-1 boundary distinguish a structural algorithmic failure mode. It is not only a numerical recomputation or arbitrary named finite slice. Limits to separate scalar Ritz quotients and fixed paired candidates are explicitly disclosed.
